name: nopurple
problem: AI decks all look the same: blue gradients and topic titles
promise: Slides and charts that look designed by a person

features.title: Slides that lead with the number
features.detail: Each title is the point as a sentence, with the real number up front

features.title: Charts with one clear point
features.detail: Grey bars, one accent colour, values labelled, scales that start at zero

features.title: Six calm themes
features.detail: Paper, ink, swiss, forest, sand and mono, the same for slides and charts
